mentions.name: Orderin
mentions.description: This app enables buying food directly from farms using a multi-agent system: an admin agent handles financial transactions and app management, a subscriber agent handles ordering and shopping, a market agent works with farmers or markets, a catering agent handles processing and recipes, and a delivery agent manages cold chain, delivery, and storage. The agent roles are intended to be delegated over time, with the basic structure already in place.
mentions.problem: Buying food directly from farms is logistically daunting.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I am creating an ambitious app that uses agents

Admin: -> handles all financial transactions and manages the app

Subscriber:-> entity who orders/shops

Market: -> the agents that work with the farmers or markets

Catering: -> for any processing or recipes

Delivery: -> handles cold chain, delivery, storage

Initially I will do everything but the idea is to delegate the agents

The basic structure is in place

https://github.com/peterretief/orderin
